messages:
frank: Noticed a 404 in the onboarding quickstart. The curl example links to /docs/quickstart#auth-setup-v2 but that fragment doesn't exist anymore after the heading rename. Anyone own quickstart.md?
geeta: That file lives under docs/getting-started/quickstart.md IIRC. We renamed a couple of headings last sprint. Can you paste the exact broken link?
frank: It's in the sample in docs/integrations/slack-setup.md, line that says: `curl https://help.redwood/internal/docs/quickstart#auth-setup-v2` -> 404 on staging preview.
alejandra: Oof. Two options: add a doclinks redirect from /docs/quickstart#auth-setup-v2 -> /docs/quickstart#authentication-setup, or restore the old heading slug. I prefer redirect + update the sample to canonical path to avoid future churn.
frank: agreed redirect + canonical update is safest. Small PR ok?
geeta: I'll take it. Steps I'll run locally:
```
# find occurrences
rg "quickstart#auth-setup-v2" -n docs || true
# branch
git checkout -b docs/fix/quickstart-auth-fragment
# apply update in place
python -c "import sys,re; p=sys.argv[1]; s=open(p).read(); s=s.replace('quickstart#auth-setup-v2','quickstart#authentication-setup'); open(p,'w').write(s)" docs/integrations/slack-setup.md
# add doclinks redirect
python - <<PY
import yaml
f='doclinks.yaml'
try:
  d=yaml.safe_load(open(f)) or {}
except FileNotFoundError:
  d={}
d['/docs/quickstart#auth-setup-v2']='/docs/quickstart#authentication-setup'
open(f,'w').write(yaml.safe_dump(d))
PY
```
alejandra: Nice. Also add `owner: "dev-ex"` in quickstart frontmatter so alerts route correctly. docops-bot will like that.
docops-bot: docs-lint:info  Missing owner in frontmatter detected for docs/getting-started/quickstart.md.
geeta: Will add owner and a one-line changelog entry. I'll run `npm run docs:link-check` locally before pushing.

geeta: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1223  Changes: - update sample link in slack-setup.md - add doclinks.yaml redirect - add owner frontmatter to quickstart.md - changelog line

frank: thanks CI, I remember a legacy file that still points to the old fragment. geeta can you sweep legacy dir too or add an extra redirect?
geeta: I'll add another doclinks entry for the legacy path and update the two small files. Pushing fix in same PR.

alejandra: quick review: looks good. small nit: prefer the redirect key use repo path without host e.g. `/docs/quickstart#auth-setup-v2`. Also add a test in docs/tests/test_doclinks.py asserting redirect exists.
geeta: done, added test and squashed commits. PR updated.
alejandra: LGTM. Approving.
frank: approve as owner of slack integrs sample.
geeta: merged. I'll follow up to ping the integrations team to update any external references and note this in the release notes.
docops-bot: docs-deploy: staging preview published for PR 1223.
frank: Verified staging preview - link resolves and sample works. thanks team!
